dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Hmph! That Imaginarium Theater... It's clearly the work of a witch!

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: But that suits me just fine! I'll treat this as a dress rehearsal — a chance to refine my "Witchhunter Training Program."

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: This is a personal grudge between me and that witch. I absolutely will not accept defeat.
